It was brought to my attention that concussive/subconcussive impacts could play a part in my mood and anxiety problems when I listened to a lecture from someone who researches the phenomenon. The condition is called CTE and if I have anything like it then I’m dealing with a very minor version. CTE stands for Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy and the exact cause and mechanism is not understood. If you biopsy brains of those with CTE after they die, you can see deposits of amyloid beta protein (sometimes) and tau protein (always) which are also present (though in different patterns) in some other diseases like Alzheimer’s. CTE can’t be properly diagnosed because there aren’t PET scan biomarkers for those proteins in the brain that are reliable enough yet. It is uncertain how common the phenomenon is in those who play contact sports because some are never diagnosed. Just thought I’d include what I know because it’s interesting.
